# Encord

> > Encord is a multimodal data layer platform for Physical AI that helps 300+ teams train and run AI on the right data through annotation, curation, and evaluation workflows.

Encord provides end-to-end data infrastructure for AI teams, from data labeling and curation to model evaluation and RLHF workflows. The platform supports computer vision, LLMs, and generative AI applications across industries including autonomous vehicles, robotics, healthcare, and manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- Physical AI
- Multimodal Data
- Data Labeling
- Data Annotation
- Data Curation
- LLM
- VLA (Vision Language Models)
- RLHF
- Human-in-the-Loop
- Model Evaluation
- Computer Vision
- Autonomous Vehicles
- Data Infrastructure
- Encord Index
- SAM 2

## Platform & Core Products

- [Encord | Train and Run AI on the Right Data](https://encord.com): Encord multimodal data layer for Physical AI, trusted by 300+ teams
- [The Data Layer for Physical AI | Encord](https://encord.com/physical-ai): Encord data layer for Physical AI with VLA models and robotics support
- [Data Labeling Platform with Scalable HITL Workflows | Encord](https://encord.com/annotate): Encord annotation platform with AI-assisted workflows and HITL features
- [Multimodal Data Mgmt & Data Curation Tool for AI | Encord](https://encord.com/encord-index): Encord Index: multimodal data management and curation for AI applications
- [Multimodal Data Curation Tool for AI | Encord](https://encord.com/curation): Encord data curation tool for CV, NLP, and LLM applications

## AI Training & Evaluation

- [Multimodal AI Training Data Evaluation Workflows | Encord](https://encord.com/post-training-alignment): Encord platform for RLHF, DPO, and model evaluation workflows
- [Annotate and evaluate multimodal data for Generative AI](https://encord.com/frontier-and-generative-ai): Encord Frontier for generative AI annotation and preference data generation
- [Design & Deploy Supervised Learning Workflows](https://encord.com/applied-ai): Encord platform for supervised learning workflows across healthcare, manufacturing

## Enterprise & Services
